name: SEPTEMBER THE FIRST
source:
Main heroine meets this first September on board the space training ship. Her actions will have different outcome there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
